response.sql:
WITH telescope_counts AS (
  SELECT telescref, COUNT(*) AS signal_count
  FROM signals
  GROUP BY telescref
),
total AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_signals
  FROM signals
)
SELECT tc.telescref,
       tc.signal_count,
       CAST(tc.signal_count AS REAL) / NULLIF(total.total_signals, 0) AS fraction
FROM telescope_counts AS tc
CROSS JOIN total
ORDER BY fraction DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Only telescope references appearing in signals are included; the fraction is each reference’s signal count divided by the total number of signals.
